code:
# -------- 52 Sheet and enums
Enum: Suit
  case HEARTS
  case DIAMONDS
  case CLUBS
  case SPADES
Sheet: Ranks
  column rank: Text
  column rank_code: Text
# -------- Joker Sheet and enums
Enum: JokerKind
  case RED_JOKER
  case BLACK_JOKER
Sheet: JokerSeed

# -------- Shared geometry and palette
let border_inset: 0.5
let field_inset: 1
let border_color: #151515
let paper_color: #fffdf8
let back_color: #17233c
let back_icon_size: 3.2

# ------ Card Frome/border
Template: CardFrame
  param fill: Color

  Rectangle: "Border"
    x: [border_inset]
    y: [border_inset]
    width: full - [border_inset] * 2
    height: full - [border_inset] * 2
    color: [border_color]

  Rectangle: "Field"
    x: [field_inset]
    y: [field_inset]
    width: full - [field_inset] * 2
    height: full - [field_inset] * 2
    color: [fill]

# ------ Poker Front
Template: PokerFront
  let ink: if [suit] == Suit.HEARTS
        or [suit] == Suit.DIAMONDS
           then #c62828
           else #151515

  let card_icon: "[rank_code]_[suit]"
  let corner_inset: 2.2
  let corner_size: 3.2
  let center_size: 10

  CardFrame:
    fill: [paper_color]

  Icon: "Center mark"
    x: half
    y: half
    size: [center_size]
    pivot: center
    color: [ink]
    code: [card_icon]
    style: flat_dark

  Icon: "Top corner"
    x: [corner_inset]
    y: [corner_inset]
    size: [corner_size]
    pivot: top_left
    color: [ink]
    code: [card_icon]
    style: flat_dark

  Icon: "Bottom corner"
    x: full - [corner_inset]
    y: full - [corner_inset]
    size: [corner_size]
    pivot: top_left
    rotate: 180
    color: [ink]
    code: [card_icon]
    style: flat_dark
# ------ Re-usable 2 icon pair for making the Back
Template: BackIconPair
  param code: Text
  param dx: Number
  param dy: Number

  Icon:
    x: half - [dx]
    y: half - [dy]
    size: [back_icon_size]
    pivot: center
    color: [paper_color]
    code: [code]
    style: flat_dark

  Icon:
    x: half + [dx]
    y: half + [dy]
    size: [back_icon_size]
    pivot: center
    rotate: 180
    color: [paper_color]
    code: [code]
    style: flat_dark

# ------ Poker Back
Template: PokerBack
  let ring_inset: 1.5
  let ring_thickness: 0.3
  let ring_inner: [ring_inset] + [ring_thickness]

  CardFrame:
    fill: [back_color]

  Rectangle: "Light ring"
    x: [ring_inset]
    y: [ring_inset]
    width: full - [ring_inset] * 2
    height: full - [ring_inset] * 2
    color: [paper_color]

  Rectangle: "Back field"
    x: [ring_inner]
    y: [ring_inner]
    width: full - [ring_inner] * 2
    height: full - [ring_inner] * 2
    color: [back_color]

  BackIconPair:
    code: "HEARTS"
    dx: 4.5
    dy: 5

  BackIconPair:
    code: "DIAMONDS"
    dx: -4.5
    dy: 5

  BackIconPair:
    code: "CLUBS"
    dx: 4.5
    dy: 0

  BackIconPair:
    code: "SPADES"
    dx: 0
    dy: 5

# -------- Card Definition 52
Card: PokerDeck
  sheet: Ranks
  size: poker
  x_units: 24
  y_units: auto
  loop: Suit as suit
  Front: PokerFront
  Back: PokerBack
# ------ Joker Front
Template: JokerFront
  let ink: if [joker] == JokerKind.RED_JOKER
           then #c62828
           else #151515

  let corner_inset: 2.2
  let corner_size: 3.2
  let center_size: 10

  CardFrame:
    fill: [paper_color]

  Icon: "Center Joker"
    x: half
    y: half
    size: [center_size]
    pivot: center
    color: [ink]
    code: [joker]
    style: flat_dark

  Icon: "Top Joker"
    x: [corner_inset]
    y: [corner_inset]
    size: [corner_size]
    pivot: top_left
    color: [ink]
    code: [joker]
    style: flat_dark

  Icon: "Bottom Joker"
    x: full - [corner_inset]
    y: full - [corner_inset]
    size: [corner_size]
    pivot: top_left
    rotate: 180
    color: [ink]
    code: [joker]
    style: flat_dark

# -------- Card Definition Jokers
Card: JokerDeck
  sheet: JokerSeed
  size: poker
  x_units: 24
  y_units: auto
  loop: JokerKind as joker
  Front: JokerFront
  Back: PokerBack
name: PokerDeck
